speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin my evaluation, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you been traveling to any specific locations recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Your consumption of ice cream three days prior to symptom onset is a crucial clue; does this ice cream contain unpasteurized milk or cream? Additionally, have you or anyone you live with noticed similar symptoms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The combination of fever, headache, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant woman with a history of consuming unpasteurized dairy products is highly suggestive of listeriosis. I am requesting a blood culture and a serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) level to confirm the diagnosis and assess severity. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture; REQUEST TEST: Serum_LDH
